newsitem.title: USA: Musicland bank group extends waivers.
newsitem.headline: Musicland bank group extends waivers.

text.p: Musicland Stores Corp said Friday its bank group extended waivers of existing financial covenants in its senior credit agreement through May 29, 1997.
The original waivers were granted last October and were to expire on March 30.
Musicland said ongoing discussions with equity investors have ended, but added this does not preclude future talks with potential equity investors.

Musicland said it is negotiating with the bank group additional financing and further waivers and/or amendments of existing covenants. It added there can be no assurance that the outcome of these discussions, which it called "crucial" to its financial position, will be successful.

As of December 31, Musicland, a specialty retailer of pre-recorded home entertainment products, operated a total of 1,466 stores. This included 87 Media Play stores, 158 On Cue stores, 422 Suncoast stores, 777 Sam Goody/Musicland stores and 22 United Kingdom stores in 49 states, the United Kingdom, Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands.
